notes:
User is a beginner runner aiming to complete a 10K by the end of summer. Current activity includes 30-minute outdoor walks during lunch 3x/week and substantial gym cardio; available training time is 4–5 hours/week. User prefers gradual, manageable progression, wants to increase continuous jogging in small increments, and values rest, injury prevention, sustainable pacing, varied routes, and listening to their body.

User is building a gym routine for core and legs, especially liking Pallof Presses and Bird Dogs, and enjoys variety. They have done planks, Russian twists, and other core work and want oblique-focused options such as side planks, woodchops, cable/band rotations, side crunches, and Pallof rotations. Start conservatively and emphasize controlled form. They are also working on flexibility and range of motion, particularly hamstrings and hip flexors; interested in dynamic stretching, longer static holds, yoga/Pilates, and consistency. Sustainable exercise advice: schedule workouts, start small, vary routines, make them convenient, track progress, use small rewards, and resume gently after missed days.

User enjoys high-energy cardio music and asked for playlist ideas. Suggested categories included Spotify Beast Mode, Cardio Kickstart, HIIT/Cardio Blast/Sweat Session, electronic/hip-hop/rock mixes, and custom playlists with upbeat songs. They plan to try several.

User is doing well and reports losing 10 pounds over the past 3 months since consistently going to the gym. Previously reported about 5 lb in one month and approximately 2,500 calories burned per week; avoid reinforcing obsessive calorie tracking. Encourage balanced sustainable habits, strength progress, recovery, and professional guidance if needed. Energy-maintenance interests include hydration, pre-workout snacks, electrolytes for longer/hot sessions, caffeine in moderation, pacing, breathing, sleep/recovery, and post-workout nutrition.

Motivation/accountability preferences: celebrates small victories, tracks workouts/calories/weight in a fitness app, responds well to milestone-based goals and rewards, and values reporting progress to someone. Plans to find a running buddy through online platforms or local beginner running groups, ideally with a similar level and goal.
